Name: Hudson Valley Buildings - Complete Pack
Author: oomps62
Description:
[size=5][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#9fc5e8][b][u][img]https://i.imgur.com/FksoSgb.png[/img]
[/u][/b][/color][/font][b]Hudson Valley Buildings - Complete Pack - Update for Stardew 1.6 with added color compatibility![/b][/size][size=3]

[size=5]Hudson Valley Buildings Pack for[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url][/size]

[/size][size=4]This pack includes Hudson Valley Style for all stardew farm building exteriors: farmhouse, greenhouse, player cabins, coops, barns, silo, mill, sheds, obelisks, clock, slime hutch, fish pond. Additionally, smaller farm features like pet bowls, mailbox, and beehouses are included. [/size][size=3]

[/size][size=4]There are seasonal overlays for:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Vanilla world color[/size]
[*][size=3]Starblue Valley[/size]
[*][size=3]Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolour
[/size]
[/list][size=3][size=4]
[/size][/size][size=4]Ten colorways with two variants (Bright and Muted) each![/size][size=3][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Amherst (white base; green accents; green roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Cobleskill (white base; black accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Fahnestock (green base; green accents; brown roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Garrison (purple base; green accents; brown roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Glenmont (red base; blue accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Nantucket (blue base; blue accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Rhinebeck (cream base; blue accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Saratoga (pink base; pink accents; pink roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Stonybrook (cream base; green accents; brown roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Woodbury (yellow base; maroon accents; brown roof)[/size]
[/list]
[/size][size=4]I've spent the past month putting a ton of work into expanding this content pack! Many buildings have had small fixes or minor changes, the seasonal variations are now applied differently than before to make it easier to add additional color compatibility, all 7 multiplayer cabins have been newly designed, and all the buildings have had expanded colorways by offering a muted color option. As of right now, I don't plan to expand this any further myself, but please reach out to me if you are interested in adding additional compatibility![/size][size=3]

[/size][size=5]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SGig75h.png[/img]
[/size][size=4]This is a content patcher release that encompasses several mods:

[/size][list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1478]Hudson Valley Buildings[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42013760]Magimatica[/url]﻿ (be sure to check out her version for different variations on some buildings!)
[/size]
[*][size=4]Obelisks, Cabins, Slime Hutch, Beehouses, Pet Bowls, Mailbox, and modifications by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51094596]oomps62[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1771]Seasonal Grandfather Clock[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50604466]endohare[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Expanded colorways by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51094596]oomps62[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Seasonal overlays for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿ (1.6 unofficial linked, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]original here[/url]) by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/strangelyliteral/about-me?gameId=1303]strangeliteral [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51094596]oomps62[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Seasonal overlays for[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255] Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51094596]oomps62[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Yarnthebarn/about-me]yarnthebarn[/url]﻿, uses tree/flora sprites from DaisyNiko
[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/il1i6cH.png[/img]
[size=5]How To Install[/size]

[size=4]1. Make sure you have SMAPI installed

2. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in your Mods folder
[/size]
[size=4]3. Download the Hudson Valley Buildings file and then extract the zip file into your Mods folder [Note: your mods folder is located where you have the game installed]
[/size]
[size=4]4. Launch the game to create a config.json file, then close the game.

5. Open the config.json file with a text editor like notepad++ or sublime text. Edit the parameters to match your desired colorway, color saturation, foliage, beehouse style, and trailer color (see options below), then save the file
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Colorway: Amherst, Cobleskill, Fahnestock, Garrison, Glenmont, Nantucket, Rhinebeck, Saratoga, Stonybrook, Woodbury[/size]
[*][size=4]Saturation: Bright, Muted[/size]
[*][size=4]Foliage: Vanilla, Starblue, Earthy[/size]
[*][size=4]Beehouses: Classic, Realistic[/size]
[*][size=4]Trailer Color: Main, Accent[/size]

[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FFJ5Gcq.png[/img]
[/size][size=4]Please don't hesitate to reach out to me if you would like to contribute to this mod or use assets for your own mods! I am on discord as [b]oomps62[/b] (you can ping me in the main stardew valley server or DM me) or you can message me here and hopefully I see it in a reasonable time period. I am willing to share some of my resources which may make edits easier for expansions or alterations of this mod![/size]
